source.quote: Gustard X30 user manual (v1.05) and retailer specification tables, read 2026-11-20: USB at PCM 16-32 bit 44.1-768 kHz, native DSD to DSD512, DoP to DSD256; coaxial, AES and optical at PCM 16-24 bit 44.1-192 kHz with DoP64. Two I2S inputs, one on the maker's own pinout and one adjustable.
